## Checklist (Definition of Done)
- [ ] Code reviewed (self-review is fine when working alone: read the diff once)
- [ ] Tests added/updated and passing (`pytest`, `npm test`)
- [ ] No secrets, `.env` files or personal data committed
- [ ] New/changed endpoints are validated, authorized and rate limited where needed
- [ ] Database change? Alembic migration included and `alembic check` passes
- [ ] Docs updated (`docs/`)
- [ ] CI is green; deployed to staging and smoke-tested
